context: Hello, how are ya?!
I'm good, how are you?
I'm well. Definitely feels like a Tuesday haha
I hear that! I'm ready for the weekend already. Might see a movie. Do you have any movie recommendations?
You can say that again, I am too! I could definitely try to point ya in the right direction! What kind of movies are you into?
Cool! I mainly like drams and comedy. This time of year I love Christmas movies.

You can never watch too many Christmas movies around the holidays. There's a new movie that just came out actually, it's called 'Last Christmas' with Emilia Clarke! She's a great actress in my opinion!
What's it about? She sounds familiar.
It's a romantic comedy! She works as an elf every year at the store and meets a boy who turns her world upside down. Perfect holiday movie!
Oh yeah! I actually mentioned that one to my wife. We ended up seeing Playing With Fire instead...hated it. I think we'll see Last Christmas!
I thought Playing With Fire was interesting! But good choice, give the trailer a look!
Yeah, I definitely will. Thanks for the recommendation!
Of course, enjoy!
What did you like about Playing With Fire?
I love John Cena, he's corny but it works for him!
I love Cena too. I'm a huge wrestling fan (The Rock is a better actor). I've like his other stuff, but this one just dragged for me.
Dwayne Johnson is awesome! I love him and Kevin Hart. What do you mean, dragged?
Rock and Kevin Hart are awesome together! Dragged like I kept waiting for something to be funny and grab  my attention...never happened.
Oh yeah, I understand that. It's a great family movie for kids though!
It definitely is. My wife and daughter liked it
Hey, happy wife, happy life! Hahaha
